answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 69506 Country: India Title: Marriage in the month of Muharram Question: Is this permissible to marry in month of Muharram please explain with Hadith and Quranic verses? Answer ID: 69506 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1082/1067/M=12/1437) It is lawful to marry in the month of Muharram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
